The gated row must never be weakened. Its only protection is the test.fail mark: mutant M3 shows that removing the mark makes the run report 1 failed on the live 409. If a future lane edits an assertion inside E2E-25 instead of removing the mark, the row will still read as an expected failure while proving less. The header says so; nothing mechanical enforces it.

Whether a gated row COUNTS toward the umbrella's acceptance is the owner's decision, not this lane's. Council decision 7 proposes the mechanical exclusion; PK-umbrella-acceptance-unsatisfiable is where that is ruled. Until it is ruled, E2E-25 is an authored, gated, non-passing row.
